jobs.title: Data Analyst (RSCH DATA ANL 2 RP)
jobs.description:
Under direction of the Global South Center Director, the new hire will focus on data analysis, research implementation, and project coordination across multiple funded research initiatives. The analyst will support research within the global automotive transition sector, with a particular focus on electric vehicles, battery supply chains, and the market and policy forces shaping the sector. Under general direction, the analyst will contribute to the design, execution, and reporting of research activities, working collaboratively with researchers, staff, and students. The role emphasizes applying established research methods, managing datasets, and producing high\-quality analytical outputs to inform project outcomes and stakeholder engagement.

 **Apply By Date**


9/7/2026 at 11:59pm  



**Qualifications**

**Minimum Qualifications \- For full consideration, applicants are encouraged to upload license and/or certification if required of the position**

* Bachelor's degree in engineering, energy, transportation, or a closely related field
* Minimum one year of relevant professional or research experience with working with large EV and supply chain data sets, assessing market trends in different geographies, supply chain mapping, and working with advanced softwares like Python and R\> (internships and thesis research are welcome).
* Demonstrated experience in quantitative data analysis, including working skills in visualization tools such as Tableau, Power BI, or Python libraries, R, Excel or similar.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to synthesize complex information clearly and concisely.
* Working skills in analysis and consultation.
* Knowledge of EV and battery supply chains, including raw materials, manufacturing, and logistics considerations

 **Preferred Qualifications**

* Familiarity with the global automotive market and an understanding of electric vehicle technology and commercialization trends
* Experience of working in a global team and cross collaboration on multiple projects Knowledge, Skills,

 **Key Responsibilities**

* 70% \- Research and Analysis
* 20% \- Reporting and Dissemination
* 10% \- Collaboration and Project Support

 **Department Overview**


The UC Davis Institute of Transportation Studies (ITS\-Davis) is the leading university\-based sustainable transportation program in the world. Founded in 1991 to conduct and  

share multidisciplinary research on emerging and important transportation issues and to improve transportation education, the institute now has more than 120 graduate students  

working with 60\+ faculty. Our programs focus on energy and environment, advanced vehicle technologies, transportation fuels, land use planning, consumer behavior, and new mobility—all with an eye toward contributing to sound regional, national, and international transportation policy

jobs.title: Field Technician
jobs.description:
Are you ready to build a career where every day brings new challenges, hands\-on learning, and meaningful environmental work? Provost \& Pritchard is seeking a motivated **Field Technician** to join our Environmental team.

  



You will spend most of your time in the field collecting samples, supporting drilling and well installations, and collaborating with engineers, scientists, contractors, and clients. You will also build technical skills through data analysis, reporting, mapping, and project coordination.

  



If you enjoy working outdoors, solving problems, learning by doing, and contributing to work that matters, we’d like to hear from you.

  


**What You’ll Do:**


* Collect soil, soil vapor, indoor air, groundwater, surface water, and other environmental samples.
* Conduct aquifer and pump testing, drilling oversight, and soil logging in support of monitoring well projects, including monitoring well installation, development, purging, and sampling.
* Maintain clear, accurate field notes, sampling logs, forms, and project documentation.
* Coordinate with drillers, surveyors, equipment operators, laboratories, landowners, regulatory agencies, subcontractors, and clients.
* Assist with environmental investigations at contaminated or hazardous sites, including inspections, data collection, and technical support.
* Organize data for reports, spreadsheets, databases, maps, graphs, and cross sections.
* Support permitting and regulatory compliance activities, including work involving California Well Standards and agencies such as Regional Water Quality Control Board (RWQCB) and Department of Toxic Substances Control (DTSC).
* Help coordinate subconsultants, requests for proposals, schedules, and field activities.
* Contribute to projects that meet established scopes, schedules, budgets, quality standards, and safety requirements.

  


**Qualifications:**


* A high school diploma or GED is required; an Associate or Bachelor’s degree in geology, engineering, environmental science, or a related field is preferred.
* Interest in environmental investigation, remediation, and field\-based work.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills.
* The ability to prepare accurate field documentation and technical records.
* Working knowledge of Microsoft Excel and comfort learning databases and other technical software.
* A detail\-oriented, dependable approach and the ability to work both independently and as part of a team.
* Sound judgment, professionalism, and a commitment to safety.

  


**Certifications:**


* OSHA 40\-Hour HAZWOPER certification is preferred but not required.

  


**What to Expect**



This is an active, hands\-on position with approximately **70% fieldwork and 30% office\-based support**. You will work outdoors in changing weather conditions and may travel or work early mornings, evenings, weekends, or extended hours depending on project needs.

  

Candidates must be able to lift and move up to 50 pounds and perform field activities that may involve standing, walking, stooping, kneeling, crouching, crawling, working near water, and wearing Level D personal protective equipment.

jobs.title: Project Coordinator - Power Delivery Project Management
jobs.description:
WSP is currently initiating a search for a Power Delivery Project Management Project Coordinator.
 

Be involved in projects with our Project Management Team and be a part of a growing organization that meets our clients' objectives and solves their challenges.  



This position should be based out of Denver CO, Fort Worth TX, Boise ID, Saint Louis MO, Kansas City MO, Ann Arbor MI, Columbus OH or remotely from any mutually acceptable location.


**This Opportunity**
--------------------

Provides advanced administrative and logistical support to project teams by coordinating activities that promote operational efficiency, documentation integrity, and cross\-functional collaboration. Oversees complex assignments requiring the ability to interpret project plans, manage information workflows, and ensure timely execution of critical tasks. Works independently with minimal supervision to resolve issues, implement process improvements, and contribute to successful project delivery. Serves as a key liaison between Project Managers, Project Leads, internal departments, and external stakeholders to facilitate seamless project coordination and reporting


**Your Impact**
---------------

* Lead or assist the Project Manager in creation of project setup.
* Develop and maintain detailed project logs, schedules, Financial Reports and status reports for use by internal teams and clients.
* Coordinate the creation, formatting, and finalization of client deliverables, ensuring consistency and adherence to established standards.
* Lead the creation, administration and distribution of critical documentation including contracts, financial reports, submittals, RFIs, and project Change Orders.
* Track project milestones and proactively follow up with team members to ensure completion of assigned responsibilities.
* Manage internal documentation systems and repositories, applying version control and audit protocols.
* Serve as a primary point of contact for project\-related inquiries, supporting internal and external communication flows.
* Collaborate with Procurement and Finance teams to monitor project budgets, coordinate invoice approvals, and ensure timely payments.
* Assist with data entry and verification for cost reports, timesheets, and vendor submissions.
* Facilitate project meetings by preparing agendas, recording notes, tracking action items, and distributing follow\-up materials.
* Support onboarding of project staff by coordinating required access, credentials, and documentation.
* Assist in the resolution of administrative and logistical challenges by identifying root causes and recommending improvements.
* Coordinate updates to project dashboards and reporting tools, including cross\-checking input from multiple contributors.
* Provide support in audit and compliance reviews by compiling required documentation and maintaining detailed records.
* Ensure documentation related to safety plans, quality assurance, and regulatory requirements are maintained and distributed appropriately.
* Contribute to the development and refinement of templates, procedures, and project coordination workflows.
* Monitor the use of shared project resources such as drives, software platforms, and communication tools to ensure team\-wide alignment.
* Lead or co\-lead administrative segments of large projects or task orders requiring coordination between multiple offices.
* Serve as a resource and provide guidance to more junior staff on project coordination practices.
* Anticipate risks related to schedule, documentation, or compliance, and escalate appropriately with recommendations.
* Track deliverable production cycles and assist in developing timelines and quality check protocols.
* Exercise responsible and ethical decision\-making regarding company funds, resources, and conduct, and adhere to WSP’s Code of Conduct and related policies and procedures.
* Perform additional responsibilities as required by business needs.

**Who You Are**
---------------

**Required Qualifications**

* High school diploma or equivalent.
* Minimum of 5\+ years of relevant post\-education experience in related job capacity.
* Strong understanding of project lifecycles, including planning, execution, and close\-out phases.
* Demonstrated ability to independently manage multiple priorities in a fast\-paced project environment.
* Advanced proficiency with Microsoft Office Suite and project tracking tools such as Smartsheet, MS Project, or Excel\-based trackers.
* Experience with documentation management platforms such as SharePoint, Procore, or similar systems.
* Knowledge of administrative controls related to contracts, invoicing, and procurement activities.
* Strong attention to detail and commitment to maintaining data accuracy and integrity.
* Ability to interpret and implement project coordination policies, procedures, and standards.
* Professional communication skills for drafting correspondence, managing inquiries, and presenting project updates.
* Experience compiling data and generating reports tailored to diverse audiences and stakeholders.
* Capacity to identify process inefficiencies and suggest or implement enhancements.
* Comfort navigating cross\-functional relationships between technical, administrative, and financial teams.
* Strong problem\-solving skills with the ability to resolve non\-standard challenges using sound judgment.
* Skilled in time management and able to monitor and coordinate across multiple task owners and deadlines.
* Ability to work independently with minimal direction and to prioritize tasks based on changing project needs.
* Experience managing documentation associated with subconsultants, contracts, and permits.
* Ability to maintain confidentiality and handle sensitive materials appropriately.
* Track record of contributing to successful team coordination on medium to large\-scale projects.
* Ability to lead documentation audits or coordinate data gathering during internal or external reviews.

jobs.title: Staff Geologist/Staff Engineer
jobs.description:
Overview:

NV5 is a provider of engineering and consulting services to public and private sector clients, delivering solutions through six business verticals: Testing, Inspection \& Consulting; Infrastructure; Utility Services; Environmental Health Sciences; Buildings \& Program Management; and Geospatial Technology. With offices nationwide and abroad, NV5 helps clients plan, design, build, test, certify, and operate projects that improve the communities where we live and work.  

As engineers, architects, construction/program managers, environmental professionals and beyond, we play a significant role in shaping our communities through the services we provide. We are looking for passionate, driven individuals to join our team focused on *Delivering Solutions and Improving Lives*.  

We’re seeking a motivated **Staff Geologist/Engineer** to join our team and play a key role in supporting our Project Managers, Engineers, and Geologists on a variety of exciting field and construction projects.  

In this hands\-on role, you’ll assist with **site investigations, construction observations, drilling operations, borings, test excavations, field data collection, and technical report preparation**. This is a great opportunity for someone who enjoys getting out in the field, building technical expertise, and contributing to projects from investigation through completion.  

The ideal candidate is comfortable working outdoors and should be prepared to spend up to 10 hours per day in the field. Responsibilities may include operating a nuclear density gauge and working with moisture\-density testing equipment as part of quality assurance and construction monitoring activities.  

We offer a **flexible hybrid work environment**, with opportunities to work in the **field, office, and remotely from home**. Join a collaborative team that values professional development, career advancement, and investing in your long\-term success. **What we offer:*** Flexible hybrid schedule (field, office, and remote work)
* Great benefits package
* Opportunities for career growth and mentorship
* Diverse, hands\-on project experience
* A supportive and collaborative team environment


If you’re looking to grow your career in geotechnical consulting and enjoy a balance of fieldwork, technical challenges, and teamwork, we’d love to hear from you!  


Responsibilities:
* The position includes performing geotechnical field exploration.
* Writing daily field reports and maintaining exploration logs.
* Performing laboratory testing.
* Candidates will be part of a team that conducts geotechnical analysis and prepares engineering reports and project deliverables.
* The team observes construction to ensure compliance with design documents.
* **This role is 80\-90% field exploration/investigations and 10\-20% technical review, writing, and reporting.**


Qualifications:
* BS in Geology or Engineering; a Master's in Geotechnical Engineering is a plus
* 0\-3 years of experience
* Must be able to work in all weather climates, as this role is largely in the field
* GIT is a plus
* Must be able to lift, carry, and pull up to 50lbs of equipment.
* Must have a valid driver's license
* Passion for learning, flexible to work an ever\-changing schedule per construction requests.

**The pay range for this position in Oregon is $30\.00 \-$35\.00 per hour**. Base pay offered may be higher or lower depending on job\-related knowledge, skills, experience, and location of the candidate. Restricted stock units may be provided as part of the compensation package, in addition to a full range of medical, financial, and/or other benefits, dependent on the position offered.  

All local employment laws apply. Base pay information is based on market location. Applicants should apply via the NV5 careers site.  

NV5 offers a competitive compensation and benefits package including medical, dental, life insurance, PTO, 401(k) and professional development/advancement opportunities.
NV5 provides equal employment opportunities (EEO) to all applicants for employment without regard to race, color, religion, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, national origin, age, disability, genetic information, marital status, amnesty, or status as a covered veteran in accordance with applicable federal, state and local laws. NV5 complies with applicable state and local laws governing non\-discrimination in employment in every location in which the company has facilities. This policy applies to all terms and conditions of employment, including, but not limited to, hiring, placement, promotion, termination, layoff, recall, transfer, leaves of absence, compensation, and training.
